feed.title: Google Cloud: Apigee Edge for Public Cloud
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Apigee Edge for Public Cloud

entry.content:
Apigee Edge for Public Cloud release notes are now published on this page.

Release notes for Apigee Edge for Public Cloud, including its Edge UI, SSO, Message Processor, and integrated portal components, are published here from September 2026 onward. You can subscribe to this page with a feed reader to be notified when a new release is published.

Release notes published before September 2026 remain available in the Apigee Edge release notes archive.
entry.summary: Release notes for Apigee Edge for Public Cloud components are now published on this page starting September 2026. You can subscribe to this page for updates. Earlier release notes are available in the archive.
entry.title: Announcement: Apigee Edge Release Notes Available
